positiveEvidence: First-party Edison Next press release dated 2026-04-30 identifies the Galbusera Tre Marie site at Via Guglielmo Marconi 20, Agrate Brianza (MB), with exactly 12 charging points: 2 Quick AC columns at 22 kW and 4 Fast DC columns at 120 kW.
The same first-party release states a launch promotional direct tariff of EUR 0.59/kWh VAT included on all DC columns at that site, accessible via POS card payment and EVWAY.
Fresh public station data crawled 2026-09-09/10 at the exact same address exposes exactly 12 IT*EDN EVSEs: 8 CCS 120 kW and 4 Type 2 22 kW, matching the first-party physical configuration.
negativePaths: No current official network-wide Edison Next tariff was established.
The Agrate Brianza EUR 0.59/kWh figure is explicitly site/subpopulation specific and must not be propagated to other Edison Next EVSEs.

The first-party price evidence is dated 2026-04-30 and describes a launch promotion without an explicit validThrough date. Fresh station data proves the EVSE mapping still exists but does not prove that EUR 0.59/kWh is still the current tariff on 2026-09-10. Therefore the eight DC EVSEs remain fail-closed for price ranking until current-price validity is reconfirmed.
The four AC EVSEs have no first-party tariff value in the cited release and remain fail-closed.
